name: Fusaba Aino
source: A young girl who repairs the wind turbines on the edge of town. She's good at mechanics and conducts rather dangerous experiments with her homemade airplane to be able to soar through the sky. Sometimes she lands using an umbrella. Her and her father both live alone near the town workshop.
